title: Environment Config

body.text: setup script, dependencies, env variables, and internet access
— set it once to match your project, and every task can run tests and build just like a real machine.

example: "Setup script: npm install && npx prisma generate — every task starts with all dependencies ready"

title: AGENTS.md — the AI's guidebook

body.text: AGENTS.md file in the repo to state the project's rules
— how to run tests, what the code structure is, which conventions must not be broken. Codex reads and follows it automatically.

example: "AGENTS.md: 'Run tests with npm test / use TypeScript strict / no any / commit messages in English'"
